Purdue University

Purdue Solar Racing

#1 -

Artemis

CLASS
SOV
Country
United States
Competing in

ASC & FSGP

The current generation of Purdue Solar Racing was resurrected in 2023 with Apollo, placing 2nd, at the Shell Eco Marathon. After that in 2024, PSR built Lux to compete in FSGP and ASC 2024. After completing FSGP and coming in 6th place in ASC for SOV, PSR built Artemis to compete in FSGP and ASC 2026!

The MIT Solar Electric Vehicle Team (SEVT) was founded in 1986 by James Worden and is run by undergraduates.
